digest.component_or_area: ticket state schema and write surfaces
propositions: bridge_project (tri-state: absent/empty-string/key) and repos (list) fields must be added to ticket_state schema, seeded in make_initial_state, and projected by reducer on CREATE and EDIT events
create-time arguments --bridge-project and --repos must be added to all three write surfaces (CLI create_cli, library _lib_writes, MCP _mcp_writes) with identical resulting state
bridge_project is promote-only on the edit path: setting it on an unbound ticket succeeds, but changing it on a ticket with an existing binding is refused with non-zero exit and no state change
repos is freely editable post-create via edit_core/edit_cli without binding constraints
tickets created before this change must replay to identical state except for the absence of the two new fields
